name: Kranebitterhof
beschreibung: The campsite Kranebitterhof is located in the Kranebitten district in the west of Innsbruck. The location is characterized by the Nordkette and the Stubaier Alpen. Nearby run hiking trails and in winter the ski areas of the Nordkette and Patscherkofel. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. The facilities include sanitary buildings, electrical hookups and a supply and disposal station. A kiosk on the grounds supplies guests with food. Guests can expect a quiet atmosphere and a view of the mountains.
